scope: Central register for verification findings; no T01–T10 app defect inferred before execution.

severity_policy.P0: Unsafe/wrong scored rule or key, corrupted acceptance/input, lost answer identity or release of held item; block every affected gate.
severity_policy.P1: Required content/route/runtime/accessibility unavailable, broken package/source dispatch or material approved-design/readability failure; block affected gates.
severity_policy.P2: Reproducible lesser correctness/usability/editorial defect; block its required acceptance case until fixed/retested or explicitly dispositioned under existing approved scope.
severity_policy.P3: Optional polish or new feature request; record separate scope, do not silently change approved design.

workflow: Record actual expected/observed case and exact candidate before proposing a fix.
10L1 classifies and bounds the fix, affected IDs/files and invalidated tests/platforms.
10L2 applies authorized fix; new visual design requires imagegen preview and explicit approval.
10L3 reruns original failure and affected dependent checks; retain failed evidence and link superseding run.
Close only with exact fix/retest evidence; a policy exclusion is not a way to hide an observed required-case failure.

findings.expected: Indexed document hashes traced to their exact historical Git blobs.
findings.observed: Initial verifier anchored 657fef8; hashes correspond to subsequent handoff-completion commit 4270d58.
findings.reproduction: Initial diagnostic retained in ../10A1/initial-diagnostic.json; git show history reproduces both hashes.
impacted_gates: input readiness only; no T gate executed
findings.fix_scope: Change historical blob anchor to verified 4270d58; preserve original failed diagnostic and all historical receipts.
findings.approval_if_required: No visual/content change; routine verifier correction within authorized 10A1.
findings.invalidation: Initial baseline result superseded by corrected fresh full reconciliation; no app runtime result existed.
findings.retest: All nine 10A1 reconciliation checks pass; all 932 bound hashes and 484 original/bundled bindings remain exact.
findings.closure_reason: Exact historical blobs found and matched; no unexplained candidate drift.

known_limits.detail: Six bounded unit drafts retain some existing 1 litres text. Preserve exact accepted drafts; review as editorial limitation, not a changed numeric key or authorization for a broader rewrite.
M01-L01 and M10-L03 have no primary/related bank item; M07-L04 zero primary/one related. Three briefs exist, not new scored IDs.
Physical iPhone, native desktop product/bridge, cross-engine/cold-offline web and excluded listening claims remain unperformed per scope matrix; required platform checks are not_run.
Prior 9O7 did not exercise external Open source callback. New exact-URL dispatch/failure/return cases are required; lack of old evidence is not a current app failure or an exclusion.

390/1280 preview widths are conceptual, not minimum supported widths. Test measured native bounds, 390 replay and 320 narrow diagnostic; preserve 220 dp assessment and 380 dp wide-reference artwork constraints.
